title: Integral shift and scalar cocycle predicate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\Omega/\mathbf Q_\ell$, schemes $Z,X$ and $f:Z\to X$. Given integral strict direct-image comparison data $D$ [def-sf-strict-direct-image-scalar-data], define $a^W_{E,L,M}$ by the published integral scalar associator followed by equality transport along the coefficient-inclusion composition law. HasIntegralCoherence requires that each comparison commute with native shifts, and that for $E\subset L\subset M$ the two composites $I_M S^Z_{M/L}S^Z_{L/E}\to S^X_{M/E}I_E$ agree: first use the two direct-image comparisons then $a^X$, or first apply $I_M(a^Z)$ then the comparison for $M/E$.
